entry.title: Kettle's on, special brew today · /special-brew opens

Pour the cup, hear the brass chime, count the cups poured by the room. Today: the rotation picks one — open the page to see what.

entry.title: UES Track 05 — The Rebuildable Town · a field study in inhabitable software
